Hangover probiotics are supplements—most notably [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXJ_XlsBZnLlDIRbDIrZBFT1RMvAQ4b3c9Nd0W7zeZ3xkUQegNYNW0SqRGO6xdNMEI2fVi38hYsb87WlMIiZTcdNyiM21YzBo3fRQRDOT-m6H7wBOQ3iw6wEo7xmM) Pre-Alcohol—designed to break down acetaldehyde, a toxic byproduct of alcohol metabolism in the gut, to help reduce next-day hangover symptoms. While early research on specific probiotic strains is promising, clinical evidence proving they reliably prevent hangovers is still limited, and they do not lower blood alcohol content or prevent intoxication.⁠ZBiotics  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXJ_XlsBZnLlDIRbDIrZBFT1RMvAQ4b3c9Nd0W7zeZ3xkUQegNYNW0SqRGO6xdNMEI2fVi38hYsb87WlMIiZTcdNyiM21YzBo3fRQRDOT-m6H7wBOQ3iw6wEo7xmM)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:594673468853034043,catalogid:326721977575300080,gpcid:12790976527101995330,mid:576462807816504738&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wcpPTrtc-aV3z8Gklr1Sh3yscCOPfn2piR6xVrz8Men5-KYKF1NMorjrBKfLwXQhXYFNdl6V3nybuqwjElcAzyNT20MWEHScA3MVrXETdca147zD7SyX7EkEcLnAoyf-exGfP41LdkgbH_MdCC6uW08k4w-gib9v8KIHGPyhbLK-P0)

### How They Work

- **Acetaldehyde breakdown:** Engineered strains like *Bacillus subtilis* ZB183 produce enzymes that break down acetaldehyde in the digestive tract.⁠ZBiotics  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXJ_XlsBZnLlDIRbDIrZBFT1RMvAQ4b3c9Nd0W7zeZ3xkUQegNYNW0SqRGO6xdNMEI2fVi38hYsb87WlMIiZTcdNyiM21YzBo3fRQRDOT-m6H7wBOQ3iw6wEo7xmM)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:594673468853034043,catalogid:326721977575300080,gpcid:12790976527101995330,mid:576462807816504738&ibp=oshop)
- **Gut & oxidative stress support:** Some probiotic strains (such as *Leuconostoc mesenteroides* VITA-PB2 ) have shown potential in early trials to support ethanol clearance and reduce oxidative stress.⁠National Institutes of Health (NIH) | (.gov)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXsQ-a3O8oV-fn6Y3cvy6m_YhJuyu9Zl7pnIMKF3CPjGnle1lKt2w4GBezy4t5kCBTuyOyOX-pVMxXC3dVRvpQ8lFS1Qf3cmLhcV2izYy-fMI2D-ilMRiT_Ypi6Yy2V5fsmRVMWyXrBPM)
- **Limitations:** Experts note acetaldehyde also affects the liver and brain, and probiotics cannot replace hydration, pacing, or moderating alcohol intake.⁠Time Magazine[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1wcpPTrtc-aV3z8Gklr1Sh3yscCOPfn2piR6xVrz8Men5-KYKF1NMorjrBKfLwXQhXYFNdl6V3nybuqwjElcAzyNT20MWEHScA3MVrXETdca147zD7SyX7EkEcLnAoyf-exGfP41LdkgbH_MdCC6uW08k4w-gib9v8KIHGPyhbLK-P0)
